svg.title: Ichor Steamship clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: Redrawn as clickable vector paint cells directly from traveltransit_passenger_on_steamship.svg and the related supplied transit reference images. Click a cell to paint it. Shift-click paints every cell carrying the same number.
